description: Synthesize selected results into an executive-ready readout.
promptText: Review the selected Bulk Analysis results as context. Produce an executive synthesis with the common themes, important differences, decisions needed, recommended actions, and evidence gaps that require follow-up.

description: Identify priority risks, controls, owners, and mitigations.
promptText: Use the selected Bulk Analysis results as source context. Identify the highest-priority risks, existing or missing controls, likely control owners, suggested mitigations, and the evidence that supports each finding.

description: Find missing evidence and unresolved questions across selected results.
promptText: Using the selected Bulk Analysis results, list missing evidence, unresolved questions, ambiguous ownership, and the smallest next action needed to close each gap.

description: Map compliance obligations to concerns, workflows, and proof points.
promptText: Review the selected Bulk Analysis results and create a compliance obligation crosswalk. For each obligation or concern, identify the impacted workflow, supporting proof points, missing evidence, risk level, and recommended next action.

description: Convert findings into owner, action, due date, and control-test format.
promptText: Use the selected Bulk Analysis results to draft a control owner action plan. Include each finding, accountable owner or owner role, action required, suggested due date priority, control test, and evidence needed for closure.

description: Summarize process impact, affected teams, dependencies, and rollout risk.
promptText: Analyze the selected Bulk Analysis results and produce an operational impact brief. Summarize affected processes, impacted teams, dependencies, likely rollout risks, sequencing concerns, and the checks needed before implementation.

description: Convert selected results into a practical delivery brief.
promptText: Analyze the selected Bulk Analysis results and draft an implementation brief with recommended delivery steps, dependencies, decisions needed, open questions, and a short validation checklist.

description: Identify data defects, reconciliation checks, root causes, and remediation priorities.
promptText: Use the selected Bulk Analysis results to identify data defects, reconciliation checks, likely root causes, remediation priorities, affected downstream processes, and evidence needed to confirm each issue is resolved.
